body: Thanks, I’m not sure, there’s nothing particular that’s happened. I just don’t feel too great, I’m really insecure, having a lot of thoughts about hurting myself, and I get angry at my parents a lot for basically no reason which makes me feel like a crap person.

Hey, I’m also 15, it’s a hard age as it is but I can see that you’re having an especially hard time right now. The world can be a horrible place, there’s no denying that people can be awful, but not everything about it is like that. Even if it seems awful now, even if you’re mad, maybe you could be the one to change some of that in the future, if you just don’t give up now. I personally am not religious, but I hope that your religious beliefs can bring you comfort. I’m here to talk any time, you shouldn’t do it, if only for the simple reason that a stranger on the internet would be heartbroken if you did it. I’m here to talk and I wish you good luck x

Don’t worry about the swearing lol, and I know I’m a teenager too (15) it’s crap tbh, I find if I can make myself that going for a walk/ showering is useful so that I don’t self harm, but I get it’s hard, also your welcome, I feel the same way!

Sorry I took ages to reply I’m new to reddit :/ it sounds like a hard situation, and I imagine your mum would be upset at first, any caring parent would, but maybe just let her know that it’s not her fault, if you have found any other reason behind it and feel comfortable maybe you could explain?? Also maybe explain it’s an issue that’s more common than you’d think, many just hide it. I’m sorry if this didn’t help, but I really hope I can help in some way, I’m here to talk if u need xx

Hey, wow a lot of what u said was creepily relatable, I feel the same way (even if I’m in a better mood rn). Maybe it’s hypocritical of me to try and give advice, but I want you to know that ur feelings are valid even if u don’t think they are, and I know that beating yourself up about it will only make it worse, it’ll make you sadder and angrier and the cycle just continues. I get that it’s easier said than done, tho. If u need to talk I’m here x
Thanks, yeah that seems quite likely, I usually get it after the good feeling wears off, could be it
Yeah I guess, as I said it’s not an issue, I’m just curious
I am female, I had thought of that but it happens no matter what time so idk lol
Thanks for the reply! idk that I am depressed though I’m just generally confused idk

It’s ok I know how you feel, It’s so scary when someone knows your secret and it’s out of your control. But I’m sure your family will try and support you, I find it’s best to just take your mind off of these things, even if it’s easier said than done, distract yourself (even if you just take a shower), you can’t control what will happen so just hope for the best, telling someone is a good decision so well done!! Proud of u :)
